 Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
Date : January 20, 2023 P.C. :

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned App for the State.
2.
These are the applications for pre-arrest bail.

The applicants are apprehending
arrest in connection with C.R. No. 614 of 2022 registered with R.A. Kidwai Marg
Police Station, for the offence punishable under sections 419, 420, 465, 467, 468,
470, 471, 474 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

Darshan Patil 903-aba-111-112-23.doc
3.

The complainant stated that a substantial sum of money amounting to more than Rs.25 lakhs was taken by the applicants in cash from him with the assurance that a room under SRA scheme will be Akshay Vijay Gurav vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96550354/
1 alloted to him.

entities.text: Akshay Vijay Gurav vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The complainant realised that he has been cheated as the room is not handed over.
4. It is the case of the learned counsel for the applicants that right from the year 2010 onwards, the applicants have been pointing out illegalities with respect to the said project.
The applicants contend to be whistle blowers.

The complainant's relative is the chief promoter of the society and therefore,
the complainant has been set up at the instance of the chief promoter.
The applicants are related to each other as father and son.
5. Learned APP seeks time to take instructions.
The case for interim protection has been made out.

6. Meantime in the event of arrest of the applicants in connection with C.R. No. 614 of 2022 registered with R.A. Kidwai Marg Police Station, the applicants- Akshay Vijay Gurav and Vijay Budhaji Gurav, be released on bail on their furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each with one Darshan Patil 903-aba-111-112-23.doc or more sureties in the like amount.

7. The applicants shall report to the Investigating Officer of the concerned Police Station on 23/01/2023 and 24/01/2023 between 11.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m.
8.
Stand over to 03/02/2023.

(M. S. KARNIK, J.)
